Big Blue는 2분기 매출이 월스트리트의 희망에 미치지 못하는 1% 증가에 그칠 것으로 예상한다고 밝혔습니다.  CEO 아르빈드 크리슈나(Arvind Krishna)는 투자자들에게 보낸 서한에서 회사가 소프트웨어에서 데이터 센터 인프라로 기업 지출이 전환되는 추세에 보조를 맞추지 못하고 있다고 말했습니다. :: 11% 11%는 2분기 글로벌 스마트폰 출하량이 2013년 이후 최저 수준으로 하락한 수치입니다. 이는 메모리 칩 부족으로 인해 스마트폰 가격이 상승하고 수요가 위축됐다고 밝힌 카운터포인트 리서치(Counterpoint Research)의 초기 추정에 따른 것입니다. 공급업체가 가전제품보다 AI 데이터센터 고객을 우선시하면서 메모리칩 가격이 급등했다. :: 경쟁사의 경쟁력에 맞춰 폭스바겐에서 50,000 50,000개의 일자리를 줄여야 할 수도 있습니다. items.titleOriginal: The Week In Numbers: SK Hynix shares plunge, mass Volkswagen layoff fears
items.summaryOriginal: STORY: From a huge hit for SK Hynix shares to mass layoffs at Volkswagen. :: The Week In Numbers This is The Week In Numbers. :: 15% 15% is the fall SK Hynix shares took in trading on Monday in the South Korean chip giants biggest one-day decline on record. It came just days after it's U.S. listing as investors in Seoul cashed out of a massive share price rally following its Nasdaq debut last week. Monday's stock drop kicked off a volatile week for the company's shares. :: 25% 25% is the plunge IBM shares took after it signaled the AI infrastructure boom is drawing spending away from the software sector. Big Blue said it expected revenue to rise just 1% in the second quarter, falling short of Wall Street hopes.  In a letter to investors, CEO Arvind Krishna said the firm had "faltered" in keeping pace with a shift in corporate spending from software to data-center infrastructure. :: 11% 11% is the hit global smartphone shipments took in the second quarter falling to their lowest level for the period since 2013. That's according to early estimates from Counterpoint Research, which said a memory chip shortage has driven up smartphone prices and dampened demand. Memory chip prices have soared as suppliers prioritize AI data center customers over consumer electronics. :: 50,000 50,000 jobs may need to be cut at Volkswagen to match the competitiveness of rivals. That's what its CEO told staff in an internal memo. It effectively confirms for the first time that the automaker is looking to reduce up to 100,000 positions. Sources also told Reuters last month VW could close four German factories.  :: $14.8 billion $14.8 billion is the equity value Uber placed on German firm Delivery Hero, as it launched a takeover bid of the food-delivery company. Were a deal to go ahead it would create the largest food-delivery group outside China. An acquisition would further the U.S. ride-hailing firm's efforts to build a global food-delivery business, as competition with U.S. and European rivals heats up.
